output.evidence: raw.orders has 15000 rows, stg_orders only 14941 rows (59 missing). The stg_orders SQL filters out orders with order_date within the last 7 days (where o_orderdate < max(o_orderdate) - interval 7 day). This filter drops recent orders, causing orphaned lineitems (230) and freshness check failure (1 stale row). Raw data shows no orphaned lineitems, so the issue originates from the stg_orders model code.

output.explanation: Removed the date filter that excluded the most recent 7 days of orders. This restores the missing 59 orders, resolves orphaned lineitem relationships, and fixes the freshness check. No other columns or types were changed.
